description: This is a PHP unit test class for testing the ThemeAPI within the OrangeHRM corporate branding module. It contains test methods to verify getOne, delete, and update functionalities of the API, utilizing fixtures and mock objects.

classes.name: ThemeAPITest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for the ThemeAPI, testing retrieval, deletion, and updating of theme entities via API endpoints as part of the OrangeHRM corporate branding plugin.

methods.name: testGetOne
methods.description: Tests the retrieval of a single theme via the ThemeAPI.

methods.name: dataProviderForTestGetOne
methods.description: Provides test case data for the testGetOne method from a YAML configuration.

methods.name: keepOnlyDefaultThemePreHook
methods.description: Removes the default theme entity from the database before certain tests.

methods.name: testDelete
methods.description: Tests the deletion of a theme via the ThemeAPI.

methods.name: dataProviderForTestDelete

methods.name: testUpdate
